verses.1: The words of Jehovah, which were spoken to my master Micah during the time of Jotham. Hezekiah, king of Judah, who saw everything that happened in Shomron and Jerusalem.
verses.2: Hear, all nations! Listen carefully to the earth and its contents. May the temple of Jehovah be among you forever; may it be a place of holiness.
verses.3: For behold, the LORD will come out from His place, and He will descend and walk across the land.
verses.4: And the mountains below them were destroyed; the deep valleys were filled with flames, like water flowing in a river.
verses.5: In Yaakov’s sins, all of this happened. And in the sins of the house of Israel, it also happened. It was because of Yaakov’s sins that Shomron perished, and it was because of Jerusalem’s destruction that the Jews suffered.
verses.6: And I set up markers along the edges of the field, at the corners of the plots of land. I also marked off its boundaries and boundaries with stones.
verses.7: And all her possessions will be destroyed, and all her structures will be burned down by fire. All her decorations will be destroyed as well. For from this time onward, nothing will remain of them.
verses.8: Therefore, I will gather and bring together all those who are evil and wicked. I will make them suffer from the punishment that they deserve. But their houses will be destroyed.
verses.9: For she is a woman who is cursed; she came to Judah. She touched the gates of my people, even to Jerusalem.
verses.10: In the house of Al-Tagidu, they shall not weep. They shall not mourn in the house of Le’afra.
verses.11: I give you a place to sit in peace. Do not allow anyone to take your place from the house of the dwelling. He will take your position from you.
verses.12: For good will sit in the throne, just as evil has come down from Jehovah to the gates of Jerusalem.
verses.13: The chariot was filled with treasures. The first sin was committed by the daughter of Zion; for in her midst were found the sins of Israel.
verses.14: Therefore, give me pledges on the wine presses of Akzib’s cities, for the kings of Israel.
verses.15: And even after the inheritance is given to you, my father, you will still be seated on the throne until the time comes when Israel’s glory arrives.
verses.16: Harsh and cruel are your children, O vast and cruel one! Your cruelty is like a prison, for they have been driven away from you.
